title: Write a Grader
prompt:
Write a function `grade(score)` that returns a letter grade string:

- 90 or above returns "A"
- 80–89 returns "B"
- 70–79 returns "C"
- anything below returns "Keep practicing"

Then log the result of `grade(85)` and `grade(92)`.
boilerplate:
// grade(score) returns the letter as a STRING


// log two examples

tests.name: returns the right grade for each band
returns (does not just log)
tests.hint: Return the string from inside each branch: return "A"; — logging is not returning.

tests.name: logs two examples
